debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) + Ichimoku above cloud + Supertrend bullish + extreme fear sentiment (11/100) create contrarian setup with price near support (79.253) in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum completely absent—price below EMA-9/20, MACD bearish, RSI/Stoch/Williams-R oversold without confirmation, volume weak (0.67 ratio), macro environment in VIX crisis (352.48), and earnings risk in 52 days with zero fundamental catalysts or insider conviction.
